topics.topic: How ProofResult identity accounts for changing referenced-binding status
questions: Is ProofResult identified only by the immutable flow version, or can the same flow version have different ProofResults as referenced bindings move from proposed to accepted?
What facts determine a ProofResult when the same immutable flow version can produce different results as referenced bindings change status?
What distinguishes two ProofResults for the same immutable flow version when acceptance of a referenced binding changes the result?

judgement.why: This asks the same question about ProofResult identity under changing referenced-binding status, and the relevant passages were unchanged.

precedent.topic: ProofResult identity when binding statuses change
quotes: Substitution: proving the same version gives the same result. Continuity: none.
precedent.why: The change did not touch M17 or make ProofResult identity newly consequential.

topics.topic: Whether repeated admission against an unchanged corpus reuses or creates an AdmissionVerdict and TrialExecutions
questions: When the same implementation is submitted again against the unchanged corpus, is the existing AdmissionVerdict and its original TrialExecutions reused, or is a new verdict created for the newly minted TrialExecutions?
When the same implementation is submitted again against an unchanged corpus, is the admission verdict reused, replaced, or recorded as a new verdict associated with the newly minted trial executions?
When the same implementation is admitted again over the unchanged corpus, is the existing AdmissionVerdict reused, or is a new verdict created with newly minted trial executions?

quotes: Submitting an implementation — new, or equal to an existing one — runs admission unless an AdmissionVerdict M08 for that implementation and the current corpus digest already exists, in which case that verdict is used.
judgement.why: The later rule says the existing verdict is reused, so no new admission TrialExecutions are created for an unchanged implementation-and-corpus pair.

questions: Is NodeExecution a value identified by all of its contents, or an entity identified independently by its attempt coordinates or a minted identifier?

topics.topic: Lifecycle and status of active work when a run is cancelled or refused
questions: Can cancellation or refusal occur while another node or effect attempt is actively executing, and if so, what lifecycle and NodeExecution or EffectAttempt status applies to that already-started work after the run has ended?

topics.topic: What sensitive EffectApproval preview data is durably persisted
questions: What exactly is durably stored in an EffectApproval preview for credential-bearing headers, personal-data values, and file request bodies, especially after the run's spool is removed?

topics.topic: Where the requester of automatic read-only activation is recorded
questions: Where is the owner or agent who requested an automatic read-only FlowActivation recorded, given that FlowActivation records the kernel as `activated_by` and no activation-request model is defined?

topics.topic: Whether agent Actor identity survives token removal and reconfiguration
questions: If an agent token is removed and a token with the same agent name is later configured, do historical and new records identify the same Actor?

topics.topic: Which events and times are recorded when an unknown EffectAttempt is later resolved
questions: For an attempt first recorded as unknown and later resolved, what event does concluded_at record, and is the time of the owner's resolution itself retained?

topics.topic: Who may request activation of a proven read-only flow
questions: May an agent request activation of a proven read-only flow, or is every activation request owner-only?
